name: io.github.afeezadebayo/google-keyword-planner
title: Google Keyword Planner
description: Keyword ideas, search volumes, CPC ranges, trends and forecasts from Google Ads Keyword Planner.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud OAuth client ID (Desktop app); its project needs Basic access to the Google Ads API

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token for the adwords scope

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads account ID to query, e.g. 123-456-7890

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager account ID, if access is through a manager account

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Legacy and optional. Google retired developer tokens on 9 September 2026
